# RacketEdge

> Real court testing, no marketing hype. 

RacketEdge is a tennis and racket sports affiliate and review website founded by Chris Davies, an active competitive tennis player and gear tester. 

The primary mission of RacketEdge is to provide transparent, brutally honest, and experienced-based reviews of tennis rackets, badminton rackets, strings, shoes, and other gear. If gear hasn't been tested in a competitive match, it is not recommended on this site.

## Key Sections
- **Racket Reviews:** In-depth, play-tested reviews of the latest frames from Wilson, Babolat, Head, Yonex, and Victor.
- **Gear Guides:** Comprehensive buying guides for strings, bags, shoes, and ball machines.
- **Tennis Guides:** Educational content covering tennis rules, court dimensions, scoring, and technique.
- **About:** Information on Chris Davies and the RacketEdge "Prove It" testing methodology.

## Philosophy
The site follows a strict "Prove It" philosophy. Content is written in the first-person from the perspective of an actual player. We value stability, comfort, and real-world feel over manufacturer marketing claims. RacketEdge is reader-supported and uses Amazon affiliate links, but never accepts payment from manufacturers in exchange for positive reviews.

## Technical Details
This site is a statically generated Next.js (App Router) application. Content is served from highly optimized markdown files.
